records.title: CINELL: An Energy-Efficient Compute-In/Near-Memory eDRAM Processor for Sparse Transformer-Based Large Language Models
records.reason: CINELL proposes sparse-Transformer LLM compute-in/near-memory hardware with explicit energy, memory-access and latency claims; the publisher record exposes an abstract but not the paper body, leaving architecture/evaluation assumptions unverified.

records.title: CDP-KDNet: Curriculum-Guided Dynamic Pruning and Knowledge Distillation for Resource-Efficient Ultrasound Elastography
records.reason: The primary publisher abstract concerns pruning/distillation of a CNN for ultrasound elastography; it is a medical imaging model, not LLM inference.

records.title: MMCTOP: A Multimodal Textualization and Mixture-of-Experts Framework for Clinical Trial Outcome Prediction
records.reason: The paper applies sparse MoE to multimodal clinical-trial prediction using domain-specific biomedical inputs; it does not study LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: DeepCQ: General-Purpose Deep-Surrogate Framework for Lossy Compression Quality Prediction
records.reason: DeepCQ predicts lossy-compression quality for scientific simulation data; this is not compression of LLM parameters, activations or KV cache.

records.title: Divided We Fall: Defending against adversarial attacks via soft-gated fractional mixture-of-experts with randomized adversarial training
records.reason: The work uses soft-gated fractional MoE for adversarial robustness in generic ML; its objective is defense accuracy, not LLM inference efficiency.
